title: Better Serverlist+
description: This mod completely overhauls the Multiplayer Server list making it much better for everyday use
body:
![Hero Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41c104545a386315d003925954582aa44bf212b3_0.webp)
This mod **completely** overhauls the **serverlist** adding a lot of new **features**

### Hotkeys
CTRL + V = past the server ip to minecraft
CTRL + C = copy the current selected server ip
CRTL + A = add new Server
Del = Remove server from list

### Quality of Life
When pressing add server u now start on the Server Adress tab instead of the Server Name making u able to immediatly add the ip 

### Server Tabs
By Pressing eather one of the buttons on the side or the arrow keys u can switch through multible server lists. Making it able to sort  your Serverlist in multible sections for example SMPs and PVP trainings server. U can also Name the different Tabs.

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/600cc2d73b2b36f18e343907e4fb5e54282b5918.png)

### Auto Name detector
When adding a server the client searches for a fitting name. It takes the Name and writes the beginning big and if its found in the MOTD it will take that. It will automaticly remove most prefixes / suffixes like .com / .gg ... 
if the ip is eu.catpvp.com the name will be Catpvp

![the auto detection system](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/EuCWBNqg/images/6c2e1eee97af39b1f20ad97c1dc26d2132871bcd.png)
